verdict.rationale: Custom metadata schemas are a fair question for a cloud file-storage API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only addressing driveItems, generic search, delta tracking, versions, thumbnails and sharing. It never mentions custom properties, metadata templates, or setting and querying user-defined fields via Graph. A community remark that SharePoint adds metadata to documents is an adjacent behavior, not a developer-defined schema, so it earns no credit.
